explanation: Families build ofrendas, altars decorated with marigolds and photographs of relatives who have died, to welcome their spirits home for the celebration.

claims.text: Coco (2017) is set during the Day of the Dead (Día de Muertos).
Coco is not set during Carnival, Cinco de Mayo or Las Posadas.
During the Day of the Dead, families build ofrendas, altars with marigolds and photographs of relatives who have died.
The ofrendas are meant to welcome the spirits of the dead home.
